deviations.claim_in_article: “It looked like a very large fee would appear every time a ship passed through the strait.”
deviations.issue: This frames the proposal as a charge triggered by each ship’s passage. The Ledger specifies a proposed 20% reimbursement on all cargo passing through the strait, while leaving the collection mechanism and payment details unspecified.
deviations.explanation: The per-ship-passage framing expands the Ledger’s cargo-based scope and adds an unspecified charging trigger. Both flags are true; this wording was already present in the Japanese source.
